episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Stand-up comedian Mae is single, in recovery and stuck in a rut. But when she meets the previously heterosexual George, they embark on a whirlwind romance that promises to change their lives forever.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: When George goes away to a wedding, Mae realises that she can't cope on her own and turns to her sponsor Maggie for support. Meanwhile, George hasn't told anyone she's in a relationship with a woman.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: George's reluctance to tell her friends about Mae is taking its toll on their sex life. Can George do the one thing that scares her the most?

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: When her parents come to England, Mae tries to apologise for her past transgressions as an addict. But if she's expecting anything in return, she's going to have a long wait...

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: The arrival of George's male teenage crush exposes Mae's biggest insecurities. Can their relationship survive?

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Mae hits rock bottom. Desperate to experience some joy, she soon falls back into old destructive habits. Is she a lost cause, or can George save her?

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: In Canada, Mae tries rehab and reconnects with someone from her past. Meanwhile, a despondent George searches for a purpose in her life without Mae.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Back in England, Mae is devastated to learn that George has moved on — and disastrously attempts to have a platonic friendship with her.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: An awkward dinner with George's old friends becomes contentious after Mae receives a disturbing phone call, then picks a fight with Binky.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Mae can't wait to go on a TV show and expose a star's sexually inappropriate behavior. But George and Phil worry about how this will affect her.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: In pain and withdrawing from the world, Mae begins doing stand-up shows from her living room. Meanwhile, George tries to carve some space for herself.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Mae, George and Phil fly to Toronto, where Mae plans to confront her past head-on. Once there, she faces challenges including her parents' interference.
